Context: 1. Pay Fixation in the new Pay Structure.-

The basic pay on the date of implementation i.e., 1-1-2016 is multiplied by a factor of 2.57, rounded off to the nearest rupee and the figure arrived at is to be located in the new Pay Matrix (Refer Pages 126 and 127) in the level that corresponds to the employee's grade pay on the date of implementation, except in cases where the commission has recommended a change in the existing Grade Pay.
